text: At its meeting on March 28, 2023, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR1.2 and made recommendation to the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the presentation (March 12, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority Jarrett McDonald, Vice President of Operations, Toronto Parking Authority, will give a presentation to the Board.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the letter (March 28, 2023) from the Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee for information.
